name: s81sl_xrt3u
structural_change: s81sl_xrt3u (STW-S81e-XR 10-23, MAIN; COORD review 10-23: xrt3t/xrt3t_b failed 6x, ECO TT -15 / FF -10, worst TT bsw_c -> body mux -> c_d 574 um Manhattan (select at x 390, c_d at the W-face SW corner), rwb -> sw_d row write 424 um with logic, lo_sel -> pk 357 um (placement reg->reg -41): logic hops spanning the pin-bound 570x395 outline.  Structural: (1) W-face CTL-body copy (RTL OT_S81SL_XR_BW: ebw/wbw/vbw + bsew_c/bsww_c kept, same D, 0 cycles) for the sw_d row write; (2) register floorplan: the copies anchored FIRM pre-GPL in a box beside sw_d (reg_floorplan_place.tcl), so the long hop is the zero-logic pin-flop -> copy wire (<= ~440 um) and the select hop <= ~310 um; (3) consumer-adjacent pin plan: c_v/c_d W -> N beside is_d/cfg_d (all three body copies on one face), S face reordered bi | eg/x/rb/p | lo_d | bo (bi beside the RD unpackers, lo_d beside pk -> ci_b/bo); same bits per face except c_d (N 3.3/um, W 4.8/um); (4) k-means CTS K=32 (xrt3t_b: TT/FF spread 43.9/35.7). Same RTL cycles, benches base x2 seeds PASS, mutants hops/xhold/bwsel caught.

pin_regs.reason: Source-registered (S81-SLICE): every input lands in a flop at the pin and every output is a flop (ot_s81sl_xr header); recipe-3 pin_regs would add a second unpriced stage on every slice seam.

pin_reg_split_why: XR6 fallback (FOREG=1): fault leaves a dedicated output flop (fault <= fcore), no recirculation at the pin flop, so io_flop_at_pins anchors it; no pin_reg_split.
outline_why: ROOT4-S81POST 10-19: first xr3 (C3, HB 1) kit, from the closed s81sl_xr1f kit: same faces + the band port B (bi 1104 in, bo 513 out) on S (the slice band face: pvrd lands bi from below, bo feeds the svc entry q below). Pin-bound: 9,268 pins; S 3,276 on 570.24 um = 5.9/um sets the width, E 2,214 on 395.28 = 5.7/um the height (as xr1f); ranges spread uniformly per face, scalars 2.16 um, clk at the E-face centre. Util ~7% (std ~16k um2 est.): the 40-60% target is unreachable without cutting boundary bits (slice seam architecture), as xr1f. xrt3u MAIN: same outline 570.24 x 395.28; c_d moved W -> N (slot pin offsets change, slot_change_request filed).
